authority_legend.user_requirement: Constant the user specified for this rebuild (manual S01/S09). Not re-approved, not changed by code.
authority_legend.manual_specified: Value the manual fixes explicitly for the implementation.
authority_legend.fixture_default: Explicit fixture/demonstration choice. Valid for fixture mode only; live mode needs an actual source/labor/commercial authority.
authority_legend.demo_default: Proposed demonstration grading/recognition default (S14). Never an approved labor grade.
authority_legend.open_decision: Live semantic not yet resolved by an owner. Fixture choice recorded; live effect is a precise readiness gap.

scope.fixed_line_cap.ref: S01: never a fixed top-50 cap

scope.status_classes.ref: S04 master statuses; OD-13 (unknown statuses are quarantined, never dropped)

scope.default_basis.ref: S01 all aircraft with WIP; narrower scope needs a source-backed receipt

forecast.delivery_commitment_purpose.ref: S12 delivery hysteresis; OD-14 (accepted FORECAST plans feed the per-aircraft committed date; EXECUTABLE plans drive dispatch)

goals.obligation_days.ref: S13 GOAL FREEZE: the full-horizon plan stays separate from today's obligation set (shifts starting on the cutoff's local date)

dispatch.max_source_age_hours.ref: S13 DISPATCH source freshness: older current facts cannot release an action

admission.max_source_age_hours.ref: S05 ATOMIC ACQUISITION step 5 freshness: hours from each dataset's newest source clock (or producer loaded_at) to the cutoff; daily feeds 36, NEO snapshots 48, weekly references 168, calendars and CS windows 240. Live load cadences are an open decision

crew.rare_holders_max.ref: S11 SCARCITY: a role bundle held by at most this many members of a pool is rare there; crew choice keeps its holders for ready work that needs it

admission.max_capture_skew_minutes.ref: S05 ATOMIC ACQUISITION step 5 allowed capture skew: every dataset of one run captured within this window

travel.unknown_origin_minutes.ref: S11 bounded explicit policy: after a duty with no known aircraft location (e.g. off-aircraft training) the next aircraft needs a full changed-aircraft transfer

travel.shift_start_origin.ref: S11: unknown origin needs an explicit bounded policy

qa.crew_during_ip.ref: S10: retained crew WAIT also supported

qa.standard_includes_inspection_minutes.ref: S10 reconcile standards that embed inspection minutes (no duplicate 45); fixture standards are production-only

duration.confidence_level.ref: S08 persist confidence: order-statistic interval coverage for the consumed P75

duration.stale_after_days.ref: S08/P07 representative confidence/sample/staleness; older cohorts are unavailable, never a flat default

duration.group_fallback.ref: S08: exact group -> approved broader group -> sourced engineered -> unavailable

duration.tick.ref: S08 quantize by ceiling after estimation

cs.offset_day_basis.ref: S09 OD-05 (needed only for OFFSET_FROM_REFERENCE mode)

cs.hard_latest.ref: S09 hard latest only where policy says

rework.started_root_hold.ref: S10 started root: CONTINUATION holds remaining root work for the rework release; CLOSURE holds only the root release

parts.unresolved_used_on.ref: S10 missing linkage exposes unresolved affected scope

qualifications.group_by_critical_process.ref: S07 approved OR alternatives must be explicit

workforce.inference_stale_after_days.ref: S07 stale evidence detection (P05); live value is an open calibration

solver.budget_seconds.ref: S12 optional CP-SAT ordering stage: wall-clock limit of the relaxation solve

solver.max_probes.ref: S12 optional CP-SAT ordering stage: complete named decodes tried from one relaxation solution

solver.max_memory_mb.ref: S12 optional CP-SAT ordering stage: solver memory limit

solver.num_workers.ref: S12 optional CP-SAT ordering stage: search workers (1 with a fixed seed is reproducible; more trade determinism for speed)

explanations.timeout_seconds.ref: S16 BCAIProvider bounded timeout per attempt; live value is an operational setting

explanations.max_retries.ref: S16 BCAIProvider bounded retries after a timeout

explanations.max_candidates.ref: S16 bounded explanation request (candidates per request)

open_decisions.fixture_choice: Confirmed simultaneous crew count for the fixture.
open_decisions.live_effect: Live jobs keep TOTAL/PRIMARY/ASSIST fields. Executable crew demand needs the producer to confirm simultaneity, or role phases. Until then, live crew demand is an admission gap (FLOW_SEMANTICS_UNCONFIRMED).

open_decisions.topic: Elapsed-duration calibration from raw clock intervals
open_decisions.fixture_choice: Fixture episodes are verified elapsed-active observations (n=30 per class).
open_decisions.live_effect: No raw interval feed exists in S04. FOCUS_ACTUAL_LABOR is aggregate person effort only. Live rework P75 is unavailable until FOCUS_FN_ClockObservation is populated.

open_decisions.topic: QA hold locations, inspector roles and pool ownership
open_decisions.fixture_choice: Sourced hold points after 40/80 minutes with 20/25 allocations; QA team pool with cert QA.
open_decisions.live_effect: Inspection counts do not locate holds. Live IP QA blocks executable work when the hold location is unknown.

open_decisions.topic: Exact protected breaks, paid rest and overtime authorization
open_decisions.fixture_choice: Fixture breaks per S09; OT authorized for fixture people by an explicit fixture authorization dataset.
open_decisions.live_effect: Without a labor-source OT authorization, live OT is 0.

open_decisions.topic: CS offsets, reference anchors and date basis
open_decisions.fixture_choice: Dates already resolved; raw signed offsets preserved; LOCAL_MIDNIGHT date-to-UTC.
open_decisions.live_effect: If producer semantics are not approved, conflicting loads or offset-based rows produce CS_WINDOW_GAP / CS_CONVERSION_POLICY_MISSING.

open_decisions.fixture_choice: Station 744 unload date as an explicit planning delivery proxy plus 2-day grace (baseline_proxy).
open_decisions.live_effect: No contractual due without commercial authority. Missing due leaves modeled cost unknown, never zero.
Hard concurrency edges without an admitted meaning quarantine the affected jobs.

open_decisions.topic: Rework NC/PU/CI classification and root linkage source
open_decisions.fixture_choice: Supplemental typed rework classification with root and defect-origin evidence.
open_decisions.live_effect: Without a classification source, live rework jobs have class UNKNOWN and no P75 estimate (DURATION_UNAVAILABLE).

open_decisions.fixture_choice: Supplemental requirement census receipts for cert-free jobs.
open_decisions.live_effect: Positive-only NEO rows cannot prove cert-free work. Jobs without rows stay REQUIREMENTS_UNKNOWN (blocked).

open_decisions.fixture_choice: Explicit fixture roster and attendance with synthetic=false demonstration origin.
open_decisions.live_effect: FOCUS_PERSON_TEAM_MAP and FOCUS_ATTENDANCE_SHIFT are empty (S04), so no executable crew exists live. Inference is forecast evidence only.
Live origin needs an actual location source or approved bounded policy.

open_decisions.fixture_choice: Assumed planning terms labeled ASSUMED; no cap unless explicit.
open_decisions.live_effect: No production default rate. Missing approval or basis leaves liability unknown.

open_decisions.fixture_choice: AVAILABLE/PLANNED/IDLE open; IN WORK in progress; PREVIEW/FORECASTED forecast-only; ON HOLD/REVISIONHOLD/FAILPREVIEW/UNRELEASED blocked; unknown statuses quarantined.
open_decisions.live_effect: Until the planning system owner confirms status meanings, PREVIEW/FORECASTED work stays forecast-only and unknown statuses are quarantined with reasons.

open_decisions.topic: Which accepted plan purpose drives delivery commitments
open_decisions.fixture_choice: Accepted FORECAST plans (complete-WIP projections, conditional support labelled) feed the per-aircraft committed delivery date; accepted EXECUTABLE plans drive dispatch only. One commitment row per scope and aircraft (S06 FOCUS_FN_Commitment).
open_decisions.live_effect: Until the delivery owner confirms the purpose and date basis, the committed date is a planning commitment shown with its raw risk, never a contractual promise.

open_decisions.topic: Live observation producers (lifecycle facts, actual intervals, claims, decisions, amendments, defect evidence)
open_decisions.fixture_choice: Deterministic S18 observation feeds under fixtures/inputs/<scenario>/observations with complete producer receipts and covered-through watermarks.
open_decisions.live_effect: queries/actuals readers and 008_lifecycle.sql landing tables are proposed; live collection is NOT_PROBED, so official evaluation stays UNKNOWN until producers and receipts exist.

open_decisions.topic: Score policy approval and personal grades
open_decisions.fixture_choice: score.policy_status DEMONSTRATION with no approval receipt; personal grades disabled.
open_decisions.live_effect: An OFFICIAL grade requires score.policy_approval_ref from the owner; personal grades require their own approved policy.

open_decisions.fixture_choice: Demo persona 'excusal' holds the excusal_decider grant; claimants never decide their own claims.
open_decisions.live_effect: The operator maps reviewer subjects to the server-owned excusal_decider grant; without it no decision is admitted and relief stays zero.
